verificationScope: Three complete twinpacts and five official print images/basic data, restrictions and all exact reprints checked. Ikkodas paid4/4000 Mach Fighter, actual untapped-target entry-turn attack and native battle-win top GR summon on either turn; tie/loss/emptyGR/entrylock/ignored-source no false GR. Seed Destiny pays1 and moves one exact opponent physical card cost<=2, including top creature/seed/gear/field, under-card or zero-cost facedown seal; physical owner grave, no target safe, actual Last Burst on a top creature. Panzer paid6/8000 W2, declared attacks redirected only to legally attackable source, never grants untapped/protected attack permission or forces declaration; multiple targets, seal/ignore. Exact victorious opponent on genuine battle loss, including smaller always-win Kumo, follows actual owner mana; tie/winning-Slayer/bounce/ignored cases excluded. Spinner Bull pays1, mandatory either-side creature tap and S-trigger. Chohatsu paid6/5000+attack5000 W2; native next-opponent force timing extended only with player target obligation, dynamic later Speed Attacker covered, source departure survives, recipient ignored still externally constrained, sickness/noPlayer/noAttack respected, competing legal Panzer/player targets remain alternatives and no end-turn escape, expires after the actual next opponent turn. Longest Way paid4 and genuine S-trigger chooses enemy current power<=5000 to a new facedown shield; an attacking Chohatsu current10000 is excluded despite printed5000. Both seats, exact mana orientation, physical card conservation, AI hidden information/read-only, encrypted server action/choice continuation. Full focused100, extra current-power2, related240 plus physical/LastBurst11 and online5 passed. npm check, audit, original IDs/data/saveformats invariants passed; all previous full/long-test interruptions retained.

resolvedAttempts.name: official-1834
resolvedAttempts.reason: Initial Panzer battle fixture tapped both participants so there was no legal attack; corrected only the attacker tap state. An expiry fixture did not retain a tapped creature target through its own normal untap; corrected with actual skip-untap state. Initial purported later speed attacker and Slayer IDs were not those abilities; replaced with actual Peekap dm05-049 and Bone Assassin dm01-088 and required nonempty attack choices. Eternal Omega Maximus correctly returned to hand rather than mana, and actual Kumo correctly offered Mega Last Burst from mana; replaced the normal victor with actual Shauna and explicitly declined Kumo Mega Last Burst. New Seed Destiny used a non-destruction flag incorrectly; actual QA31778 test caught missing Last Burst, so removed that flag. All failed attempt logs retained; final verified data includes corrections. Official reprint dmex05-036 lacks only spell civilization in HTML: full image shows Fire, matches both other prints, and exact image evidence records that narrow supplement.
